$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Compact Before the Cache Expires settings: the acpmux daemon's timer that compacts an idle Claude chat while its prompt cache is still warm (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/cache_compact.rs). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file each time it arms the timer and checks this file's defaults and ranges in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentCache
lists.note: Settings > General > Prompt Cache (Leo, 2026-11-03: "idk if we maybe also wanna be showing that/opt-in autocompact around that 5min mark"; "we ought to make these all accessibly toggle-able ofc"). On by default since 2026-11-24 (Leo: "we need to be compacting arguably BEFORE cache expires...", "this can be toggled but... this as a default seems decent."): a warm compaction costs about 40% of the cold rewrite of the whole context it saves.

rows.name: cacheCompactEnabled
rows.note: On: an idle Claude chat whose context is over agents.cacheCompact.minContextPercent runs /compact about 30 s before its prompt cache expires (once per idle stretch; never mid-turn, with a prompt queued, or while someone types). On by default; off: acpmux arms no timer. ACPMUX_CACHE_COMPACT=0|1 in the acpmux daemon's environment overrides it.

help.text: Compacts an idle Claude chat while its cache is warm, so the next message costs less.

rows.name: cacheCompactMinContext
rows.note: The share of the context window (percent) a chat must be using before the timer compacts it. ACPMUX_CACHE_COMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PERCENT=N in the acpmux daemon's environment overrides it (clamped to the same range).

help.text: Chats using less of their context window than this are left as they are.

rows.name: coldWakeEnabled
rows.note: On: once a large idle chat's prompt cache lapsed, acpmux gathers the inbox notices and agent messages that would wake it into one batch on an interval (1-5 min, longer for larger or longer-cold chats) and delivers them as one turn (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/cold_wake.rs). A block, a question and the person's own prompt never wait. On by default; ACPMUX_COLD_WAKE=0|1 in the acpmux daemon's environment overrides it.

help.text: Messages to an idle chat whose cache expired wait a little and arrive together, so its context is read once.

rows.name: coldWakeCompact
rows.note: On (and agents.coldWake.enabled on): when a cold batch opens on a Claude chat whose context is at least agents.coldWake.compactAboveTokens, acpmux masks old tool output (context surgery) or runs /compact before the batch goes in. On by default (Leo, 2026-11-24: "this can be toggled but... this as a default seems decent"); ACPMUX_COLD_WAKE_COMPACT=0|1 in the acpmux daemon's environment overrides it.

help.text: A large chat whose cache expired is compacted before batched messages arrive.

rows.name: coldWakeCompactAbove
rows.note: The context (tokens) from which a cold batch compacts first. 50000 by default: the cold batches measured on one lane VM over 48 h were 76K-89K and each post-idle wake rewrote 64K-123K tokens into the cache (Leo, 2026-11-25: "if we know for a fact 50k is beter, if people can adjust it, fine"). ACPMUX_COLD_COMPACT_ABOVE_TOKENS=N in the acpmux daemon's environment overrides it (clamped to the same range).

help.text: Cold chats with less context than this are woken without compacting.
